_comment: Map each Slack channel id to a project. The bot ONLY responds in channels listed here (scoping). Get a channel id by right-clicking the channel in Slack > View channel details, or from the URL. backend 't3' routes turns into a T3 Code project (1:1 channel<->project, persona lives in that project's CLAUDE.md); backend 'claude' (default) drives the Claude Agent SDK directly with the persona/tools below.

C0YYYYYYYYY.persona: You are an engineer embedded in this project. Answer questions, triage bugs, and implement changes ONLY within this project. If asked about anything outside it, politely decline.

C0ZZZZZZZZZ._comment: require_mention (default false): set true for a channel that's ALSO used for unrelated conversation. The bot then stays silent on plain messages unless it's actually @-mentioned (or the message is a reply in a thread it already joined) -- instead of replying to every message like the default 'works without me' loop.
